videos.title: Dashing Cm Bharath
videos.description: Bharat, an Oxford graduate, becomes chief minister after his father's death. Determined to fight corruption, he faces fierce resistance and obstacles from powerful enemies.

videos.title: Ram Aur Shyam
videos.description: After escaping his dangerous brother-in-law, Ram disappears from home. His twin brother Shyam accidentally takes his place, triggering confusion, family drama, and a fight for justice.

videos.title: Hello Brother
videos.description: After being shot by tycoon Khanna, cop Vishal survives through a heart transplant. Teaming up with the spirit of his donor, Hero, he sets out to expose Khanna's drug empire and avenge his death.

videos.title: Ishqiya
videos.description: Khalujan and Babban, two small-time crooks, both fall for Krishna, their late friend's widow. But their love turns dangerous as Krishna cleverly manipulates them to serve her own selfish motives.

videos.title: Sultan
videos.description: After losing his son, wrestler Sultan Ali Khan quits the sport. Years later, he returns to the ring to reclaim his lost respect and win the prize money, reigniting his fighting spirit.

videos.title: Suhaag
videos.description: Two brothers separated by fate reunite to fight injustice, corruption and criminals, proving that courage and family bonds can overcome every challenge.

videos.title: Bumper Draw
videos.description: Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.

videos.title: Cinebuzz
videos.description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

videos.title: Nishant - The Night's End
videos.description: Vishvam, one of four brothers, rules a village with his father. When schoolmaster's wife is abducted, village revolts; is Vishvam involved, and will she reunite.

videos.title: Roti
videos.description: When Mangal, a seasoned criminal, is sentenced to death, he escapes from prison with the help of a gang lord. While he attempts to start a new life, the police look for him.

videos.title: Judwaa
videos.description: Raja and Prem Malhotra, twin brothers separated at birth, reunite by fate. Together, they fight gangster Ratanlal to protect their family and reclaim the bond they never knew.

videos.title: Dil Ka Rishta
videos.description: Jai, a wealthy man, accidentally kills Tia's husband in a car accident. Wracked with guilt, he cares for her after she loses her memory, and fate leads her to fall in love with him.

videos.title: Halla Bol
videos.description: Ashfaque, a small-town dreamer turned Bollywood superstar, sees his glamorous life take a dark turn when he becomes the key witness in a shocking murder case that puts his fame and safety at risk.

videos.title: Seetharamam
videos.description: Afreen returns to Pakistan to deliver a letter from Ram to Sita, as her grandfather wished. Meeting Ram, she discovers a moving story of love, loss, and connection.

videos.title: Raja Hindustani
videos.description: Raja, a taxi driver, marries Aarti despite her wealthy family's objections. But her stepmother plots to create misunderstandings between them, threatening their love and happiness.

videos.title: Mann
videos.description: Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to others and promise to reunite after six months to marry. But when fate intervenes, their hopes for a future together face unexpected obstacles.

videos.title: Guardian
videos.description: A wronged woman rises from the dead, driven by vengeance, to haunt and punish those who tormented her in life. Her return brings fear, chaos, and a reckoning none can escape.

videos.title: Beqabu
videos.description: Raja is killed by a terrorist he helped jail. Years later, his girlfriend meets his lookalike in Nepal and sets out to uncover the shocking truth behind it.

videos.title: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
videos.description: Prakash wants money from his suspicious father-in-law. He joins Rahul and Harry to kidnap his wife, but the plan spirals into chaos, testing friendship and greed.

videos.title: Ansoo Ban Gaye Phool
videos.description: Honest Vidyanand is jailed by a vengeful Seth. Humiliated, he vows revenge and is ready to go to any length to settle the score and reclaim his honor.

videos.title: Joroo Ka Ghulam
videos.description: Rajesh pretends to be wealthy to impress Kalpana and her family, leading to a series of comic situations and misunderstandings.

videos.title: Mere Do Anmol Ratan
videos.description: Suman gives birth after years of waiting. But a hospital fire leaves her unable to identify her baby, leading to heartbreak, confusion, and a mother's impossible choice.

videos.title: Lorie
videos.description: A young woman navigates love, ambition, and family challenges, facing unexpected twists that test her courage, resilience, and personal growth.
